name: NIQ Client - Scan a Card
title: Scan your first business card
description: Open the **Scan Portal** and scan a business card with your camera. NextIQ reads the card with AI and creates a Lead for you automatically.

name: NIQ Client - Add Voice Note
title: Add a voice note while scanning
description: While scanning a card, tap the microphone to record a short voice note — e.g. what you discussed. NextIQ transcribes it and adds a summary straight to the Lead.

name: NIQ Client - Check Balance
title: Check your scan balance
description: Open **My Balance** to see how many scans you have remaining this cycle.
